notes:
New in 0.8.0:
- Unity 6 games: taps and clicks work (they ignored every click before).
- Windows games show their text: games that ask for Windows fonts (Arial, Segoe UI, Yu Gothic, MS Gothic, Microsoft YaHei...) now find them.
- RPG Maker: taps work in games with their own menus, PC-style save screens work, no more "Animation not found" in some options screens, and games no longer freeze.
- Hold the gear in a game to edit your buttons right there, choose other buttons for the game, or adjust the screen.
- New buttons: Mouse, Drag and R-Drag sticks, and a WASD pad.
- Screen size & position: zoom, move or stretch the picture; Fit my phone screen size; Run in a window for Unity games.
- Taps hold the click a little longer, so more games notice them.
